headline: What to Do Immediately After a Traffic Collision
articleBody: Experiencing a traffic collision can be overwhelming, but knowing what steps to take right away can make a huge difference for your safety and any potential legal claims. First off, ensure everyone's safety; move to a safe spot if possible and check for injuries. Even if you feel fine, adrenaline can mask pain, so always get a medical evaluation soon after. Next, exchange information with all parties involved: names, contact details, insurance info, and license plate numbers. Don't forget to get contact details for any witnesses too! It's also super important to document the scene with photos and videos of vehicle damage, the surrounding area, road conditions, and any injuries. And absolutely, always report the accident to the police, especially if there are injuries or significant damage – a police report is often crucial for insurance claims. Remember, try to avoid discussing fault at the scene. Your priority is safety and gathering facts. If things get complicated or you're unsure about your next steps, especially with injuries involved, connecting with an experienced attorney like Brett Peterson can really help you navigate the process and protect your rights from the get-go.
